dct_title_s: Damage assessment in Ubay municipality, Bohol Province, Region VII (Central Visayas), Philippines as of 23 December 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20211216PHL** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures and buildings in ubay municipality, Bohol province, Region VII (Central Visayas), Philippines as observed from a Pleiades image acquired on 23 December 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT identified 1,751 damaged structures and 220 potentially damaged structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT.
